04 · 16 resources

Text-to-speech (TTS)

Latency, not raw quality, is what kills voice agents: prioritize providers offering true streaming with first-byte under 200 ms.

Suggested learning path: Week 3: Components

PickTypeBest for
ElevenLabsCommercialQuality, voice cloning
Cartesia SonicCommercialLowest latency for agents
Deepgram Aura-2CommercialPairs with Deepgram STT
KokoroOpen sourceTiny, CPU-friendly
ChatterboxOpen sourceCloning + emotion control

16 resources

  • ElevenLabs Docselevenlabs.io

    Industry-leading quality, voice cloning, and Agents platform in one SDK.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • Cartesia Sonic Quickstartdocs.cartesia.ai

    Sonic 3.5 (42 languages, native turn detection), sub-90 ms first-byte latency, designed specifically for voice agents.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • Deepgram Aura-2developers.deepgram.com

    Low-latency streaming TTS (Aura-2) that pairs cleanly with Deepgram STT.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • OpenAI TTS (gpt-4o-mini-tts)developers.openai.com

    Easiest plug-in TTS for the OpenAI stack.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • Soniox Text-to-Speechsoniox.com

    Low-latency streaming TTS over WebSocket with multilingual voices; pairs with Soniox STT and translation.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • Gradium TTSdocs.gradium.ai

    Streaming WebSocket TTS with 158 ms P50 time to first audio and instant voice cloning in five languages.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • Artificial Analysis: TTS leaderboardartificialanalysis.ai

    ELO, price, and speed comparison covering Rime, PlayHT, Hume, Inworld, and others.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • Best Text-to-Speech Providers in 2026 (Coval)coval.ai

    Independent head-to-head of 14 TTS providers on latency, naturalness, and cost; note the commercial author.

    IntermediateCommercial authorCommercial APIs
  • Chatterbox (resemble-ai/chatterbox)github.com

    Resemble AI's MIT-licensed TTS that beats ElevenLabs in blind preference tests; ~5 s zero-shot voice cloning, emotion-exaggeration control, and a built-in PerTh watermark. Turbo variant (350M) hits sub-150 ms first audio; Multilingual (V3, 0.5B) covers 23+ languages.

    IntermediateOpen source
  • Kokoro 82Mgithub.com

    Tiny Apache-licensed model that tops community ELO arenas; runs on CPU.

    BeginnerOpen source
  • Piper (OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl)github.com

    Fast local neural TTS optimized for Raspberry Pi; perfect for offline projects.

    BeginnerOpen source
  • Coqui TTS (idiap fork)github.com

    Maintained fork of Coqui-TTS / XTTS v2; still battle-tested, though Chatterbox now leads on zero-shot cloning quality.

    IntermediateOpen source
  • Orpheus-TTSgithub.com

    Llama-3B-based emotive TTS with ~200 ms streaming and emotion tags.

    IntermediateOpen source
  • Sesame CSMgithub.com

    Conversational, context-aware multi-speaker TTS using a Llama backbone with the Mimi codec.

    AdvancedOpen source
  • Streaming TTS for Low-Latency Agents (Picovoice)picovoice.ai

    Clear taxonomy of single, output-streaming, and dual-streaming TTS.

    IntermediateStreaming and ethics
  • Ethics of Voice Cloning & Deepfakes (Deepgram)deepgram.com

    Vendor-neutral discussion of misuse, regulation, and developer responsibility.

    BeginnerStreaming and ethics
